answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil farming by settling each epoch as an equal split among attested responders instead of per head. Clones only inflate the divisor, so an attacker's own take falls; a kinship check reads shared funding and synchronized attestation windows and drops correlated accounts out entirely. Honest tenure stays convex: only an unbroken record since the earliest epoch keeps drawing, so no fresh haven in a reset kernel restores standing. The cost curve bends upward for the attacker, and no comet of cheap clones beats it.
